index.casesTitle: In production, not in a pitch deck
index.casesDescription: Projects that real companies run on today, and the services we combined to build them.

faqs.question: Can I hire several services in a single project?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it's the most common case. A custom platform almost always includes integrations, security and handover documentation. Services aren't quoted as separate packages: we build one plan with one team.

faqs.question: How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on scope, which is why we don't publish fixed prices. You can get an estimated range in minutes with our [estimator](/en/cotizador), and after a discovery call we deliver a fixed quote with dates.

faqs.question: Can you take over a system built by another vendor?
faqs.answer: Yes. We start with a code and data audit to decide what to keep, what to refactor and what's worth replacing. If the system has become hard-to-maintain legacy, we migrate it in phases without stopping operations — see [legacy system migration](/en/servicios/migracion-datos-legacy).

faqs.question: Do you work alongside our in-house engineering team?
faqs.answer: Yes. Repositories in your name from day one, shared code reviews and documentation written so your team can continue on its own once we're done.

faqs.question: What happens after launch?
faqs.answer: You get a 90-day warranty against any technical failure, at no cost. After that you can stay with us on a maintenance plan or continue with your own team: the code and documentation are already yours.

index.ctaTitle: Running a process that no longer scales?
index.ctaDescription: Tell us what you need to solve. We reply within 24 hours with an honest technical assessment, no strings attached.
